subject: Hospitality
title: Sébastien Bazin: Accor's Reinvention
description: A short lesson to help you apply Sébastien Bazin: Accor's Reinvention.

hook.text: Sébastien Bazin took over Accor in 2013 and declared: 'We are no longer just a hotel company.' He meant it.

buildup.text: Bazin sold Accor's hotel real estate and shifted to an asset-light management model—following the Marriott playbook.

discovery.text: He then expanded into co-working (Wojo), luxury concierge services (John Paul), and food festivals. Hospitality beyond beds.

twist.text: Critics questioned the diversification. Was Accor losing focus? Bazin argued the hotel stay is only one touchpoint in a lifestyle.

climax.text: Accor now manages 5,400+ hotels across 110 countries. Bazin transformed a European giant into a global lifestyle platform.

punchline.text: Hotels, co-working, concierge. Bazin stretched hospitality beyond rooms.

quiz.question: How did Sébastien Bazin transform Accor?
options: Shifted to asset-light management and expanded into lifestyle services beyond hotels
